concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it produces the raw dataset required by T002 and downstream tasks. Because T002 (and later tasks) consume the output of T001, T001 cannot be safely run in parallel; the `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.

The plan states “T001 and T002 may proceed in parallel,” yet T002 (`code/data/preprocess.py`) depends on the data downloaded by T001. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation. T002 must be scheduled after successful completion of T001.
